title: How to replace a bike chain
description: Swap a worn 11-speed chain with a chain tool and a quick link.

steps.name: Check wear
steps.text: Measure the old chain with a chain checker; replace it at 0.5% stretch.

steps.name: Remove the old chain
steps.text: Open the quick link or push out a pin with the chain tool.

steps.name: Size and fit the new chain
steps.text: Match the old chain length, thread it through the derailleur and close the quick link.
